The match scored 0.82, but the **patronymic surname is a hard conflict**:

| | Record (CP1) | Tree (I1) |
|---|---|---|
| Name | Anders **Peder**sen | Anders **Han**sen |
| Implied father | Peder (unknown) | Hans Olsen (I2) |
| Birth year | ~1868 | ~1868 ✔ |

In Norwegian practice, "-sen" encodes the father's given name directly. **Pedersen ≠ Hansen** — they point to different biological fathers. This caps the link at *speculative* regardless of the high score, and no facts were materialized onto I1.

An event on I1 is dated more than 2 years before his birth-like fact — this contradiction pre-dates this session and needs separate attention.

1. **Resolve the patronymic conflict** — search for records that either place Anders Hansen under the name "Pedersen" in 1875 (school rolls, confirmation records, an earlier census) or identify a *different* Anders Pedersen b. ~1868 in Ringsaker. → **search-records**
